title: Context pipeline end-to-end integration, concurrency hardening, and promotion-proof repair
objective: One bounded corrective vertical-integration task (D-018): make the ONE context compiler genuinely operate end-to-end (task packet + exact requirement texts + changed/allowed-path graph seeding via a strict deterministic path extractor + bounded Unit C/E results + advisory Unit D memory + reopened source excerpts, all under one shared budget, with enforceable role sufficiency and exact provenance); one canonical orchestrator-facing entry point with grounded model routing; memory-graph transaction fix with a two-writer regression; one shared canonical path/real-path containment rule; real bounded retention; extended end-to-end benchmark with G0 baseline; input-manifest projection staleness; corrected smoke-tested runbook; one permanent additive context-pipeline CI job.
business_reason: D-018 owner corrective directive: close the vertical-integration gaps left across D-013 units without restarting the program.
inputs: Accepted D-013 units A1..F on main c123b5e (index, compiler modules, ontology, memory, views, benchmark, projection) - integrated, not rebuilt
tools/model_routing.py Signals (accepted M0-T074, consumed read-only by the new entry point)
project-control task packets + directives registry (authoritative requirement texts via directive_registry resolution incl. ALL)
D-018 requirements R006-R068 (the corrective scope); D-013 standing rows; docs/CONTEXT_PIPELINE_RUNBOOK.md commands
outputs: tools/context_paths.py - the ONE shared canonical repository-path + real-path containment rule (absolute/drive/dot/doubled/backslash/traversal/symlink-escape refusal; no private-path disclosure) adopted by context --include, deep views, graph/view seeds, ontology inputs, memory evidence paths, task-derived paths

Integrated compiler (context_pack modules): task packet + exact applicable requirement IDs AND texts (deterministic ALL resolution) + changed/allowed-path graph seeding with a strict deterministic prose path extractor + unresolved-seed recording + bounded Unit C/E results + advisory Unit D memory (absence/quarantine honest) + deterministically selected reopened source/test/contract excerpts, all under the ONE shared budget with enforceable role sufficiency (bounded machine-readable nonzero exit) and exact inclusion/omission/truncation/query/digest/coverage provenance; existing public interface preserved where practical; split proposal preserved

tools/context_orchestrate.py - the canonical orchestrator-facing entry point (outside tools/agent_supervisor/**) that invokes the integrated compiler, derives model_routing.Signals from compiled evidence (missing signals -> ambiguity/missing-evidence, never silent LOW), emits a bounded routing/dispatch manifest, and records the decision via the accepted external runtime convention

Memory-graph transaction fix: single-writer span covers load-current -> idempotency/conflict -> mutation -> validation -> promotion; two-writer stale-read/lost-update regression test; concurrent_writer + retry semantics

Real retention: bounded generation retention for index + memory stores preserving rollback generations; bounded/rotated external telemetry + routing JSONL; runtime state outside Git; redaction preserved

Extended Unit F benchmark: G0 baseline captured from accepted main BEFORE changes; 42/42 index cases retained; NEW end-to-end 5-shape corpus invoking the ACTUAL compiler (same packet/diff base/role/provider-model/reasoning/snapshot); cold/warm determinism, budget-or-split, evidence completeness, provenance, resolved graph/source evidence, advisory-memory handling, correctness vs baseline; distinct parser-version case; lock-refusal + orphan-quarantine pass predicates; corrected p95; UNMEASURED provider savings preserved
Status projection input-manifest staleness (every material input digested, not HEAD alone), full project_control.py status mapping incl. self_check + canceled, snapshot-vs-current distinction
docs/CONTEXT_PIPELINE_RUNBOOK.md corrected + smoke-tested (incl. --max-bytes), describing the one canonical compiler + honest owner-gated controller boundary
ONE permanent additive CI job (context-pipeline) running Units B-F suites + new integration/adversarial tests; no existing CI weakened
project-control/reports/M0-T069-benchmark-scope-correction.md - honest follow-up record: M0-T069's 42/42 result preserved as an INDEX-parity benchmark; its actual scope explained
project-control/reports/M0-T075-* producer evidence (G0 baseline capture, e2e benchmark report, producer report, evidence map, coverage evidence, G0 readiness)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a clean accepted task from the real ledger
acceptance_scenarios.then: real allowed/changed implementation paths resolve as graph/source seeds (prose output descriptions never used as literal paths; strict deterministic extractor only; unresolved seeds recorded); the exact applicable requirement IDs AND texts are present (directive_refs incl. ALL resolved deterministically); at least one authoritative source excerpt binds; bounded Unit C/E results and explicitly-advisory Unit D memory (absence/quarantine honest) are included under the ONE shared budget with exact inclusion/omission/truncation/query/digest/coverage provenance (D-018-R008..R018)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a materially insufficient role packet (required task/requirement/diff/source/review evidence missing, ambiguous, stale, or a code-evidence task with zero resolved graph/source evidence)
acceptance_scenarios.then: a bounded machine-readable result is emitted and the exit code is nonzero; a recorded omission is never silently treated as success; the existing over-budget split proposal is preserved (D-018-R019..R021)

acceptance_scenarios.given: two synchronized concurrent writers promoting two different valid digests
acceptance_scenarios.then: either both nodes survive, or exactly one receives concurrent_writer and succeeds on retry; both-report-promoted-with-one-node-lost is impossible; the single-writer span covers load-current through generation promotion; the exact two-writer stale-read/lost-update regression test exists (D-018-R027..R030)

acceptance_scenarios.given: absolute, drive, dot/dot-dot, doubled-separator, backslash, traversal, and out-of-repo symlink/junction paths presented to context --include, deep views, graph/view seeds, ontology inputs, memory evidence paths, and task-derived paths
acceptance_scenarios.then: the ONE shared containment rule refuses each machine-readably and no error or packet discloses a private absolute path (D-018-R031..R034)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a committed projection snapshot and then an uncommitted material control-plane change (e.g. a task status edit)
acceptance_scenarios.then: the deterministic input-manifest digest (task packets/status, verification registry, gates, submissions/review decisions, task/directive indexes, git identity) marks it STALE with nonzero exit; all real project_control.py statuses incl. self_check and canceled map to compact meanings; committed-historical-snapshot vs freshly-generated-current is explicit (D-018-R048..R050)

acceptance_scenarios.when: it is invoked for a real task and role
acceptance_scenarios.then: it calls the INTEGRATED compiler (never builds a second packet), derives model_routing.Signals from the compiled task/diff/graph/ontology evidence (missing signals set ambiguity/missing-evidence and never silently default a complex task to LOW), emits a bounded routing/dispatch manifest, and records the decision through the accepted external runtime convention (D-018-R022..R026)

the pre-change G0 baseline from accepted main is captured and compared; the existing 42/42 index cases remain green and are honestly labeled index-parity; the NEW five-shape end-to-end corpus invokes the ACTUAL compiler with identical packet/diff base/role/provider-model/reasoning/snapshot and proves cold/warm determinism, global-budget-or-nonzero-split, required-evidence completeness, exact provenance, resolved graph/source evidence, advisory-memory handling, and correctness no worse than baseline; a distinct parser-version case exists; lock refusal + orphan quarantine are pass predicates; p95 is corrected; provider token savings remain UNMEASURED (D-018-R038..R047)

acceptance_scenarios.given: index/memory stores with many generations and telemetry/routing JSONL records
acceptance_scenarios.then: bounded generation retention prunes safely while preserving rollback generations; JSONL records are bounded/rotated; all runtime state stays outside Git; redaction is preserved (D-018-R035..R037)

acceptance_scenarios.given: the CI workflow and the runbook
acceptance_scenarios.then: ONE permanent additive context-pipeline CI job runs the complete Units B-F suites plus the new integration/adversarial tests with no existing job removed/weakened/skipped/replaced; EVERY runbook command executes as written (incl. the required --max-bytes context-pack argument); the runbook describes the one canonical compiler and states honestly that controller/supervisor consumption remains owner-gated (D-018-R051..R054, R026)

risks: Touching accepted modules (Units B-E, A2 cache) risks regressions: every existing suite is in documented_test_commands and the permanent CI job; behavior-preserving integration verified against the captured G0 baseline
One-PR breadth: scope is strictly the D-018 requirement set; anything discovered beyond it becomes a follow-up task, never scope growth
